parts.name: Body
parts.Basic_description: The body of the stapler is made of durable ABS plastic, forming the main upper structure that houses the stapling mechanism.
parts.Functional_description: It holds the internal metal components and provides the pressing surface to drive staples through paper.
parts.Movement_description: It pivots around a hinge at the rear to press down and staple papers together.

parts.name: Lid
parts.Basic_description: The lid is the top cover of the stapler, made of ABS plastic, which can be lifted to load staples.
parts.Functional_description: It provides access to the staple magazine and helps guide the staples during operation.
parts.Movement_description: It rotates upward around a hinge to allow staple refilling and closes back into position for use.

parts.name: Base Body
parts.Basic_description: The base body is the bottom part of the stapler, typically made of steel for stability and durability.
parts.Functional_description: It supports the stapler during operation and contains the anvil that bends the staple legs inward.
parts.Movement_description: It remains stationary during use, providing a firm surface for the stapling action.
